notes: REF-BM-03: the save form (BookmarkEditor.tsx) exposes a title field before saving but no description field, so the auto-collected description can only be edited after saving, not before. REF-BM-06: POST /bookmarks returns the existing bookmark and the UI shows a text note ('You already saved this — showing your existing bookmark') but never opens/focuses the existing bookmark's edit form — it prevents a duplicate row but does not actively converge the user into editing it. REF-BM-10: tag autocomplete (TagInput component) only exists on the post-save edit card; the initial save form's tags field is a plain comma-separated text input with no suggestions. REF-BM-14: no '#tag' token parsing exists anywhere in search.ts/SearchBar.tsx — tag filtering is done only via separate chip UI (tagsAny/tagsAll/tagsNot), never via '#tag' typed in the query text. REF-BM-15: buildFtsMatch (search.ts) explicitly quotes every token, including AND/OR/NOT, turning them into literal search terms unconditionally (unit test 'foo OR' -> '"foo" "OR"'); there is no boolean operator or parenthesized-group support at all, i.e. the inverse of the spec's quoting rule. REF-BM-20: batch actions (db/queries.ts BatchAction) only cover addTag/archive/unarchive/delete — no remove-tag and no bulk read/unread toggle. REF-BM-24/25: no code references snapshot, HTML/PDF capture, or Internet Archive/Wayback integration anywhere in the repo. REF-BM-30/31: import/export (backup.ts, BackupPanel.tsx) use a custom 'bookmark-manager-export' JSON document, not the Netscape bookmark HTML format. REF-BM-32: no settings page or persisted personal-profile settings (font size, displayed items count) exist; sort is only a per-request filter parameter, not a stored default.
